established_physical_boundaries: Strictly mesophilic enzyme; irreversible thermal denaturation above 40 °C (Tm ~ 46.5 °C).

commercial_feasibility.commercial_verdict: COMMERCIALLY BOUNDED BY NON-BIOLOGICAL UNIT OPERATIONS: The limiting factors in enzymatic recycling are not enzyme kinetics, but mechanical pre-treatment, caustic neutralization, and salt disposal. Viable only under mandatory recycled-content regulations or brand premia.

Enzymatic TPA ($1.55-$1.65/kg) requires a 50% green premium over chemical glycolysis ($1.05/kg) or fossil PTA ($1.15/kg).
